sources.title: Geely unveils "AI-powers off-road technology" which will debut in Geely ...
sources.snippet: Geely Auto today announced the launch of its "AI-powered off-road technology". This technical suite comprises the GTA (Geely Terrain Architecture) vehicle architecture, the Thor EM-T powertrain and the AI all-terrain digital chassis. The Geely Zhanjian 700 (Geely Galaxy Cruiser 700) will be the first model to implement these technologies.

sources.title: MIRROR: Manifold Ideal Reference ReconstructOR for Generalizable AI ...
sources.snippet: Most existing AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors rely on artifact-based classification and struggle to generalize to evolving generative traces. In contrast, human judgment relies on stable real-world regularities, with deviations from the human cognitive manifold serving as a more generalizable signal of forgery.
